description:
About Our Brand and Products

Rooted Living is a nature-inspired lifestyle brand created around the idea that the spaces we live in — and the things we surround ourselves with — can help us slow down, reconnect and live more intentionally.

Our collections bring together thoughtfully designed wall art, pillows and pillow covers, mugs, and T-shirts, with a distinctive aesthetic rooted in nature, warm earthy tones, organic forms and understated beauty.

Each piece is designed to complement a calmer, more grounded way of living while adding character and meaning to everyday spaces.

What Makes Us Different

Rooted Living is more than a collection of products. It is a lifestyle philosophy centred on slow living, connection to nature and creating a home and life with intention.

Rather than following fast-moving trends, our designs are created with a timeless, grounded aesthetic in mind. We focus on pieces that feel personal, peaceful and easy to live with — products that help transform ordinary surroundings into spaces that feel considered and restorative.

We also value authentic storytelling. Our affiliate partners are encouraged to introduce Rooted Living in their own voice and share the products in ways that genuinely resonate with their audience.

How Affiliates Can Earn

As a Rooted Living affiliate, you can earn commission by recommending our products through your unique affiliate link or promotional code.

When a customer makes an eligible purchase through your referral, you receive a commission on the sale.

The more effectively you introduce Rooted Living to an engaged audience, the greater your earning potential. High-performing affiliates may also become eligible for additional opportunities, enhanced commission rates, special campaigns or exclusive brand collaborations.

Our aim is to build rewarding, long-term partnerships rather than one-time promotions.

How to Promote Us

We encourage affiliates to create natural, inspiring content that reflects both their own style and the Rooted Living philosophy.

You may promote Rooted Living through:

  • Instagram posts, Stories and Reels
  • Pinterest content
  • TikTok videos
  • YouTube content
  • Blogs and lifestyle websites
  • Email newsletters
  • Interior styling and home inspiration content
  • Product reviews and recommendations
  • Gift guides and curated product selections
  • Authentic lifestyle photography and video

We especially value thoughtful content that shows our products in real-life settings and tells a story around home, nature, creativity, wellbeing and intentional living.

Affiliates should always disclose their relationship with Rooted Living clearly and follow the applicable advertising and affiliate disclosure requirements for their platform and location.

Other Information

We are looking for creators and partners who genuinely connect with the Rooted Living aesthetic and values.

You do not need an enormous following to apply. We value quality of content, authentic engagement, audience relevance and genuine brand alignment more than follower count alone.

As Rooted Living primarily serves the United States market, preference may be given to creators whose audience has a strong U.S. presence.

Approved affiliates will receive access to their own referral tools through our affiliate platform, making it easy to track referrals, commissions and performance.

At Rooted Living, we want our affiliate community to grow alongside the brand. We see our creators not simply as promoters, but as partners in sharing a slower, more grounded and beautifully intentional way of living.

Grow with us. Share what inspires you. Earn by introducing others to a more Rooted way of living.
payout_period: Commissions are subject to a 30-day approval period and are paid monthly on the 15th. The minimum payout threshold is $25 USD. Unpaid balances below $25 automatically roll over to the next payment period.
term_and_condition:
Welcome to Rooted Living! Thanks for joining our Affiliate program.

These following terms and conditions apply to individuals who are accessing or using the Program both as a merchant (“we” or “merchant”) and an affiliate (“you” or “affiliate”) who refers customers to use product or service from the merchant.

By participating in the Program, Affiliate agrees to use the Program in the manner specified in, and are bound by, these Terms and Conditions. If you do not agree to these Terms and Conditions in their entirety you are not authorized to register as an Affiliate or participate in the Program in any manner.


1. Approve or Reject of the Registration

We reserve the right to approve or reject ANY Affiliate Program Registration in our sole and absolute discretion. You will have no legal recourse against us for the rejection of your Affiliate Program Registration.


2. Affiliate Links and Coupon

Affiliate link is automatically generated, but you can also generate an affiliate link for a specific product or collection. If a person clicks on someone else’s referral link and then later they click on yours, yours is the one that counts.

Affiliate might or might not be assigned to one coupon code with details and usage clarified on Dashboard. If customer both click on the affiliate link and use coupon code, you will not receive a double commission. If you’re not assigned a branded coupon, then you’re not allowed to promote the coupon.

Affiliate may also advertise merchant website on online channels such as Facebook, Instagram,... or offline classified channel ads, magazines, and newspapers.


3. Commissions and payment

Refer any customer to make a purchase on our website, you will get a commission amount which is calculated based on Commission structure. Commission amount is dependent on order value and not including extra fee (tax, shipping cost,...).

For an Affiliate to receive a commission, you need to specify the payment details on Settings. Payment schedule will be notified on Affiliate Guide page.

Payments will only be sent for transactions that have been successfully completed. Use of the Affiliate Program is subject to a fair use policy which gives merchant the right to review each and every referral order. Status of commission if displayed in Commission tab, any paid commission will be listed on Payment tab. Transactions that result in charge backs or refunds will not be paid out.


4. Marketing tool

We may share promotion media such as banner, logo or specific collection promotion to you through Marketing tool tab. You can download the media or get the HTML embed code in order to share on affiliate channels.


5. Network

If Network tab is activated, affiliate can invite others to become their downline affiliate. If any downline affiliate brings order to merchant shop, upline affiliate will also get network commission which depends on merchant settings.

To invite other affiliates into the system, share network link and any other affiliate who click on that link and sign up will become a downline affiliate.


6. Cookie

We use a cookie to track people who have clicked on your link, so they need to be using cookies for us to track them.

If a person doesn't allow cookies or clears their cookies then we can't track them so can't pay earnings on that person's activity.

Cookies day is said on the Affiliate registration form. The tracking day will start from the time a customer clicks on the affiliate’s link or use the coupon. Within the cookie time, every order made by this customer at merchant website will automatically result in commissions to the affiliate (There’s no need for the customer to click on the affiliate link then).


7. Removal from Referral Program

If an affiliate wishes to be removed from the affiliate program, they can do so by contacting: hello@rootedliving.studio.


Go forward and refer!

We're very glad you've made it to the end of this important document.

We wish you all the very best. You can always re-visit these Affiliate Program terms and conditions in the future and if you have any questions you can send email to hello@rootedliving.studio for support.
